chunks: An example of His delicate production, wonderful creation and deep sagacity which He has shown us is found in these bats which keep hidden in the daylight although daylight reveals every thing else, and are mobile in the night although the night shuts up every other living being; and how their eyes get dazzled and cannot make use of the light of the sun so as to be guided in their movements and so as to reach their known places through the direction provided by the sun.
ai.seo_question: What is the wisdom behind the creation of bats according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) uses the bat as a profound example of *lata'if* (subtle wisdom) in creation, highlighting how its sensory adaptation to darkness serves as a distinct sign of divine precision. This observation aligns with the Shia scholarly tradition of viewing natural phenomena as *ayat* (signs) that invite contemplation on God's omnipotence and the intricate balance of the universe.
